references.text: The promise of an eternal priesthood for Aaron's descendants, which also applies to Phinehas' lineage
Context for the promise: Phinehas' zeal stopped the plague, and God gave him his covenant of peace
Phinehas' action was credited to him as righteousness from generation to generation forever
Phinehas, son of Eleazar, is mentioned as a priest acting on behalf of the people
Phinehas' priestly lineage, confirming the eternal priesthood
Phinehas' descendants among those who returned from exile, showing the continuity of the priesthood
Atonement for the children of Israel – the priest's duty to make atonement for the people
The contrast between the Levitical priesthood and Jesus' eternal priesthood
